newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index surges in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index surges in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 59.7 points or 2.12 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 0.94 percent.
Oct 11 Oct 4 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

"The Eyres Reed Explorer Index improved 59.7 points as market interest in the speculative resource sector increased on the international bullion price firming and anticipation of September quarterly exploration results," Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
Gains outnumbered falls by a ratio of eight to five.
The star performer of recent weeks, Kanowna Lights NL, continued its run up, adding 4.5 cents to 27.5 cents.
Fortuna NL jumped 2.6 cents to 7.3 cents on anticipated results from its Yandal tenements joint venture with Great Central Mines NL.
Yardarino Mining NL firmed three cents to 17 cents, reflecting its close proximity to Plutonic Resources Ltd's Darlot Centenary gold discovery.
Golden Valley Mines NL rose 1.1 cents to 5.5 cents.

Falls included Diamin Resources NL, which fell 1.1 cents to 4.6 cents, Denehurst Ltd, down another 2.5 cents to 11 cents, Golden Tiger Resources NL, down eight to 68 cents, and Bronzewing South hopeful Audax Resources NL, down 5.5 cents at 35 cents.
